verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Mastercard Open Finance is a financial-data API platform with webhooks for event notifications (eliminating polling) and an MCP server for AI coding assistants to look up docs/generate code — but there is no evidence of an end-user-facing capability to configure autonomous background automations (e.g., a workflow/automation builder or agent runtime that executes actions on a schedule/trigger). Webhooks only notify of events; building any 'automation' still requires the developer to write and host their own logic elsewhere.
